packages.title: Atomic selected-character authorization and encounter reservation
invariants: Validate full SessionLease SessionId/AccountId/ConnectionId/Revision/ExpiresAt, selected CharacterId and Account ownership in same transaction that creates an encounter admission
No separate GetSelectedAsync then SaveEncounterAsync check-then-act; any earlier read is only display/candidate context
Stale epoch, disconnected, banned, cross-account or reselected character does not commit encounter row
Use unique intent key scoped to valid role and lease; stale session cannot receive success replay from an old idempotency key
packages.native_blocker: Actual KR Client C2S0x42 request/server accept-response/scene bootstrap and character slot semantics unknown

packages.title: Encounter aggregate, lease fencing and restart recovery
invariants: RESERVED -> ACTIVE only with valid owner/scene/lease and optimistic revision
Old lease cannot activate/advance an ACTIVE encounter after new login, renewal, revoke or ban
Terminal or aborted outcomes are monotone; never reactivate on retry
Crash after commit must reconcile from persisted state, not allocate second EncounterId; no claimed original Client behavior
packages.native_blocker: Native tutorial scene/instance transition and how original Client handles reconnect/abort not yet established

packages.title: Deterministic mock actors, AI tick, movement and event dedup
invariants: ActorId is scoped to EncounterId and derives from mock fixture spawn ordinal plus internal namespace, never a KR native NPC/Actor packet identifier
Deterministic fixture checksum+seed produce identical actor list after retry/restart; spawn event key unique
AI has one explicitly Server-owned mock authority, tick monotonic, deterministic tie-break and bounded movement inside fixture world
Reject stale tick, cross-encounter/actor/role owner, wrong ConfigDigest, duplicate spawn, forged Client AI and invalid move without changing aggregate revision
packages.native_blocker: Original Scenario14 spawn/AI/movement C2S/S2C, coordinates, waves, actor owner and rules not established
